correctness.rationale: Conditional on field capture, qPCR all-negative probability is r^m. The derived log-failure exponent has a strictly concave numerator, yielding a single global continuous peak; the adjacent efficiency ratios increase strictly in p, enforcing one crossing and an ordered no-skip integer staircase. Small scaled failure expansions prove the full coefficient of 1-p_m, and the continuous stationary equation gives the log-log correction. Verified with the actual standalone package checker (504 diagnostics), but infinite claims rest on the reconstructed analytic proof.

value.rationale: Independent field capture and technical PCR amplification are qualitatively distinct detection bottlenecks with different costs. The exact no-skip integer phase transitions and sharp p_m asymptotic provide a motivated, reusable rule about when additional laboratory replication becomes cost efficient; this is more than a one-off numerical adjustment. Model realism is limited by assumed independence, no contamination and cost linearity.
